title: Vanilla Sprinkles
description: A vanilla+ datapack that tweaks loot tables and recipes, and adds some new recipes such as new stews and anvil repairing.
body: Vanilla Sprinkles is a datapack that adds a handful of quality of life improvements, and fun-yet-simple features. Some examples are recipe and loot table tweaks, and new recipes such as new stews and anvil repairing. View changes in the gallery or [this Google Doc](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1s4aOmi6HtsSVqQFhPfu4o5MTSVye42dhWe7njapnJgc/edit?usp=sharing).
